gloss: number of digits; number of figures

definitions.gloss: number of digits; number of figures
definitions.explanation: The count of digits in a number. Also used figuratively to describe something being on an entirely different scale ({桁数|けたすう}が{違|ちが}う).

examples.japanese: ⟦パスワード→パスワード：05277_pasuwaado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{桁数|けたすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ふ}やした→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧。
examples.english: I increased the number of digits in my password.

examples.japanese: {桁数|けたすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧ほど⟦セキュリティ→セキュリティ：04867_sekyuriti⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The more digits there are, the higher the security.

examples.japanese: ⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{桁数|けたすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: The sales figures are on a completely different scale from last year.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{桁|けた}→桁：03884_keta⟧ (digit; order of magnitude) + ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ (number; count). Frequently used in technology contexts (passwords, PIN codes, data) as well as in business when discussing figures and amounts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {桁数|けたすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ふ}やす→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧: to increase the number of digits
- {桁数|けたすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧: to be on a different order of magnitude
- {桁数|けたすう}⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧: digit limit
- ⟦{有効|ゆうこう}→有効：03645_yuukou⟧{桁数|けたすう}: significant figures (in math/science)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{桁|けた}→桁：03884_keta⟧: digit; order of magnitude — the base word, also used in ⟦{桁|けた}→桁：03884_keta⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧
- {位|くらい}: place (ones, tens, etc.) — the positional value of a digit
- ⟦{文字数|もじすう}→文字数：29489_mojisuu⟧: character count — similar concept but counts characters, not just digits
